instruction: Look at freecad_task-16_input.step in FreeCAD. Use the Part Design workbench throughout; activate the Body, create new sketches on the required faces or planes, and complete all fused features in the same Body using GUI additive and subtractive features. Machine a mold insert plate with nested pockets and pads. Keep the 100 x 100 x 25 mm outer block. Cut a shallow square top recess 74 x 74 mm centered at (50,50), 5 mm deep. Through the center, cut a rectangular window 48 x 38 mm centered at (50,50) through the full plate. Inside the top recess, add and fuse two raised rectangular pads, each 20 x 10 x 8 mm, centered at (35,50) and (65,50) with pad tops at Z=28 mm; drill a blind vertical hole of diameter 5 mm and depth 10 mm from the top of each pad. Cut four vertical through mounting holes of diameter 6 mm at (18,18), (82,18), (18,82), and (82,82), each with a top counterbore diameter 14 mm and depth 6 mm. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-16_output.step using GUI only; external scripts are prohibited.
